decisions.reason: It extends the core energy-pricing and analytics offer, was given its own product page, and fits the firm's strategy of expanding a central operational platform.
A location-based gas tariff comparison is close to the firm's established utility-market expertise and is more likely to be refined or integrated further than withdrawn after only one year.
The regional electricity tariff calculator matches the firm's core billing and tariff capabilities and its standalone presentation suggests meaningful commercial commitment.
Although it appears less prominently on the website and may overlap with other tariff tools, it still supports the firm's broader platform and cross-selling logic in a growing market.
The area definition tool complements tariff, network and regional process applications and likely strengthens the configurability that differentiates the firm.

This comparison product is somewhat more exposed to consolidation because it was only mentioned on the website and overlaps with nearby offerings, but it remains close enough to the core business to retain for now.
